checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Applied 38 team-substitution swaps this session, each pairing a team exactly 1-over-target with a team exactly 1-under-target in the same age_group/half, verified through season apply's hard-verification path (round-robin/opponent integrity, host_participation, arena/date). half_total_absolute_deviation dropped from 130 to 92; deviation_count dropped from 143 to 107; teams_exact_half_targets rose from 75 to 92. Remaining deviations are mostly larger-magnitude (|deviation|>=2) or structurally exhausted; did not attempt those in this pass given the added complexity/risk of multi-unit swaps.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Unaffected by the participation swaps (no dates/hosts/arenas changed in this pass, only rosters). Unchanged from prior audit.

checklist_findings.finding: All export-consistency checks match the plan exactly with 0 mismatches.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt on?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verification remains clean (ok=true, 0 violations) after 38 team-substitution swaps. Caught and fixed a bug in my own swap-construction script mid-session (forgot to update the team's `club` field alongside `label`, which the real verifier correctly rejected as a team-identity mismatch for every cross-club swap until fixed) -- confirms the hard-verification path is doing real, load-bearing validation rather than being a rubber stamp. Verified afterward that no corrupted (club,label,age_group) triples exist in canonical state beyond one pre-existing, unrelated cosmetic mismatch (Sandefjord Penguins club vs 'Sandefjord' label, present in both touched and untouched tournaments, not introduced this session).
